question.problem:
Suppose $X$ and $Y$ are discrete random variables. Let the joint CDF of $X$ and $Y$ be $F(x,y),$ where

$$
F(7,10)=0.82,\,F(7,4)=0.11,\,F(7,2)=0.05,
$$

and the supports of $X$ and $Y$, respectively, are

$$
{S}_{X}=\{1,3,5,7,9\},\,{S}_{Y}=\{2,4,6,8,10\}.
$$

Find $P(X\le 7,4<Y\le 10).$
question.worked_solution:
Note the following:

- For a given joint PMF $f(x,y),$ we can think of each point where $f(x,y)\ne 0$ as a point mass in the plane, where the "probability mass" at each point equals the probability associated with that point.

- The joint CDF $F(x,y)=P(X\le x,Y\le y)$ is the total "probability mass" that lies in the infinite rectangular region that has its top-right corner at $(x,y)$ and whose sides are parallel to the coordinate axis.

Given the supports of $X$ and $Y,$ the joint support $S$ is a subset of

$$
{S}_{X}\times {S}_{Y}=\{1,3,5,7,9\}\times \{2,4,6,8,10\}.
$$

Let's sketch the points in ${S}_{X}\times {S}_{Y},$ which contains the joint support.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14201862/assets/9e7509e29912cc54dde9a86786f1d171a49b89e7b5f7305ef025582b3402350a.png)

Let's sketch the region corresponding to the probability we wish to find.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14201862/assets/78a130ca07be1acecc4655a557abb8d3d037da28f143d0696272d12898b6b4cd.png)

Geometrically, this region can be obtained by taking all points in the infinite rectangle that has its top-right corner at $(7,10)$ (the blue region below) and *subtracting* all points in the infinite rectangle that has its top-right corner at $(7,4)$ (the red region below).

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14201862/assets/e4ff1e7cd8259fa9bcaae75210a7a3f2aeeb547ceba46b2fb411f94133372fa2.png)

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X\le 7,4<Y\le 10) & =\overset{\text{top-right corner at }(7,10)}{\overset{⏞}{P(X\le 7,Y\le 10)}}-\overset{\text{top-right corner at }(7,4)}{\overset{⏞}{P(X\le 7,Y\le 4)}} \\  & =F(7,10)-F(7,4) \\  & =0.82-0.11 \\  & =0.71.\end{aligned}
$$
